description: Residency call schedule fairness is hard to get right by hand. Our managed service builds your call schedule with call equity worked out and the ACGME rules applied.
h1: Fair Residency Call Schedules, Without the Software Headaches
paragraph: Stop fighting complex software. Scheduling Wizard's team builds your fair call schedule, balancing every rule, with the ACGME rules applied as it is built.

cta.title: Get a Fair Call Schedule Built for You
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard uses a team that distributes call, weekend, and holiday shifts equitably across all residents. Rather than manually counting and adjusting, our team treats fairness as one of the rules of the build, alongside the ACGME requirements. The call counts come back with the schedule, giving program leadership an objective, auditable basis for fairness decisions.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure residency call schedule fairness?

faq.answer: ACGME duty hour standards include an 80-hour weekly limit averaged over four weeks, eight hours off between duty periods, and a 24-hour cap on continuous scheduled work with an optional 4-hour transition extension. We build to these rules, and to the subspecialty requirements you tell us apply.
faq.question: What ACGME duty hour rules apply to residency call schedules?

faq.answer: Manual call scheduling requires simultaneously tracking dozens of resident rules, rotating holiday and weekend assignments, honoring individual preferences, and enforcing ACGME rules, all in a spreadsheet. Any single change cascades through the entire schedule. The result is hours of manual work and fairness outcomes that are difficult to defend objectively when residents raise concerns.
faq.question: Why is building a fair call schedule so difficult manually?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard is a done-for-you managed service, not software you operate yourself. Programs submit their rules and receive finished, ready-to-publish call schedules as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you. There is no platform to learn and no annual retraining when chief residents rotate. The finished schedules can be uploaded directly to publishing platform for day-to-day access.
faq.question: How is Scheduling Wizard different from self-service scheduling software?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard's expert schedulers do this full time to produce your finished schedule. Programs do not interact with any software interface. You submit your rules, and Scheduling Wizard builds the schedule and delivers completed schedules as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you.
faq.question: Who builds the call schedules at Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard handles schedule revisions as part of the managed service. When mid-year changes occur (such as leave, coverage changes, or new rules) the affected portions of the schedule are rebuilt while preserving the fairness balance and ACGME compliance of the overall call schedule, without manually reshuffling the entire roster.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle changes to the call schedule mid-year?
